146201.overview: Cassette 9: Intelligence I is an Action game, developed and published by Interton Electronic, which was released in Europe in 1978.

424362.overview:
You are trying to attack a foreign planet which is defended by mobile laser cannons.

You have to fly your intergalactic space craft very skilfully to dodge the laser fire from the guns and at the same time try and destroy them with your own laser.

424363.overview: Leapfrog is a Frogger variant. The player controls a frog and must try to cross the screen, hopping between passing cars and over floating logs and waterlilies to the other side of a river. The game supports a two-player mode by alternating tries.
